description: This PHP class 'LeaveRequestDetailedModel' is part of the OrangeHRM project. It acts as a data model for serializing detailed leave request information into an array format suitable for API responses. It includes properties for leave details, employee info, leave balances, comments, and actions, and utilizes traits and external DTOs for normalization and date handling.

classes.name: LeaveRequestDetailedModel
classes.description: A model class for serializing detailed leave request data for API responses, implementing normalization and utilizing traits for date formatting and normalization services.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the model with a DetailedLeaveRequest object.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Serializes the DetailedLeaveRequest data into an array format suitable for API output, including leave details, employee info, comments, actions, and balances.
